subject: The problem might be that
author: YabobK34
body: The problem might be that most people who would come here don't play either of the games at the moment. And if we don't play the games we probably won't show up here to talk about it (even more so if there is nothing new happening in the game). In fact it hasn't happened a lot here since last spring when we waited for all the DLC.

subject: Yes...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Remind to write the blog of the fly's and the yttihs finger, i'm getting paid to play COD6 Modern Warfare 2, early, the decorating of MY house, Boston Legal similaritys, and the enjoyment of NCIS, and always getting caught on the repparc, with my mobile phone?

I always forget this site is about us, who play Burnout and not Burnout what we play, though it helps,lol.

I am still loving BF1943, so many fun stories and moments that I forget them, though hn6 should have video of some of the moments/battles, like when 7 of our team died in the first 30 seconds on Wake Island because our team are parc on landing craft guns.

And Need for Speed Shift drives as an arcade racer compared to Forza 3 and feels more fun. But that DownHill track on Forza 3, is such a replica of the Intial D Drift Racer road, that I am going to have to rent it just for that Track, and should have been in a Burnout game years ago, and I forgot the name of the road/track but it is sweet for drifting!

And did anyone make a driving movie replica for a free copy of NFS:Shift from the guys from Inside Xbox? I had a bucket of fun thinking some up, but no real time to do the real thing, but I will when the studio is done.

So till next time imagine a fly with ski's on, and wonder what the fly was thinking?

 Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
